title: Surjectivity of reduction on residue-class units
statement: Let $n,m$ be positive integers with $n\mid m$. Write $\mathbf Z/r\mathbf Z$ for the quotient of the integers by the ideal $r\mathbf Z$ [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient], and $(\mathbf Z/r\mathbf Z)^\times$ for its multiplicative group of invertible elements. The homomorphism $(\mathbf Z/m\mathbf Z)^\times\to(\mathbf Z/n\mathbf Z)^\times$ induced by reduction modulo $n$ is surjective.
